name: Habitat
description: Habitat with workspace Python, reusable skills and self-made tools, plus opt-in supervisor-owned world phenomena.
notes: S015-S017 (ADR-0022/0024). Executable capabilities use fresh rootless containers: no network, read-only world/root and workspace-only writes. tools.create pins sandbox-validated entry source with explicit experiment opt-in. world.observe/act/advance are supervisor services with separate phenomena configuration; their rules and private state are outside sandbox mounts. No service grants host privileges. models.ask is excluded; the container image has the Python standard library only.
